NSE IPO Fully Subscribed Amid Strong Institutional Demand

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) initial public offering (IPO) was fully subscribed by its second day, driven by significant demand from institutional investors. Among the 20 institutional investors participating in the offer-for-sale (OFS), nine were foreign institutional investors who collectively held 15.96% of the NSE prior to the IPO. Despite shareholders tendering shares, they still retain a significant stake.
